about: The pins the 2 desktop installers read: install-macos.sh, and the Windows installer.
Each URL and each SHA256 is named here only (tests/test_install_macos.py holds this), except the
FreeRouting jar's SHA256, which install.sh names too and the test holds equal.
Each 'source' says where the value was read on 2026-11-27. A 'hashed' source means: the file was
streamed from that URL through sha256sum on Linux, never saved, never run.

macos.source: kicad.org/download/macos (version, macOS 12 and newer); hashed from the url; the same SHA256 in Homebrew's cask kicad (formulae.brew.sh/api/cask/kicad.json); the folder is the cask's suite artifact

windows_x64.source: downloads.kicad.org/kicad/windows/explore/stable; hashed from the url; the same SHA256 and the user switch in winget-pkgs manifests/k/KiCad/KiCad/10.0.8/KiCad.KiCad.installer.yaml
hashed from the url (SourceForge, the ngspice project's own file area); the macOS version from formulae.brew.sh/api/formula/ngspice.json (stable 47)

java.source: Eclipse Temurin 21 JRE: api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/21/hotspot?image_type=jre (link, checksum and size of each package)

freerouting.source: install.sh's FREEROUTING_SHA256; hashed again from the url

windows_x64.source: python.org/downloads/release/python-31210 (Windows installer, 64-bit; the page gives no SHA256, only sigstore); hashed from the url

homebrew.source: brew.sh, the command on its front page; min_macos is MACOS_OLDEST_SUPPORTED="15.0" in that install.sh (raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh, read 2026-11-27), which on an Intel Mac aborts: "Homebrew on macOS is only supported on Apple Silicon processors!"
